DESC: Supplies are a profit of good trade, and they can be earned from running caravans. Employees at Milepost Zero will accept this currency for various goods and services, such as upgrading the base or hiring additional workers.

Stamps are gained by completing expeditions outside of Appalachia. Serving as more than just travel memoirs, stamps are traded with Giuseppe at the Whitespring Refuge in exchange for wares that are suitably one-of-a-kind.
Feeling S.P.E.C.I.A.L.? Change up your unique strengths by scrapping perk cards for perk coins, which can then be spent to rank up legendary perks.

While the gold standard may not be fully re-established, select traders offer their unique wares exclusively for gold bullion. Treasury notes earned from public events and faction daily quests may be traded in for gold bullion at gold press machines.
Aspiring Pioneer Scouts may earn Tadpole badges by completing Tadpole Appalachia challenges. These badges can be exchanged for rewards at Tadpole vending machines found at Pioneer Scout camps.

Pioneer Scouts who have advanced to the rank of Possum may earn Possum badges by completing Possum Appalachia challenges. These badges can be exchanged for rewards at Possum vending machines found at Pioneer Scout camps.

Legendary scrips are used to buy Legendary items from Purveyor Murmrgh at The Rusty Pick and used to attach Legendary mods to items. Scrips are gained by trading in Legendary items at a Legendary exchange machine or scrapping Legendary items at a workbench.
Durable and abundant, bottle caps are the de facto currency of the Wasteland. They are accepted by most vendors and can be found almost anywhere.
